name: v6.4.299
body:
This release contains improvements for annotation rendering, font conversion, form handling, pattern rendering, performance, text selection and the viewer.

## Changes since v6.3.289
* Bump the stable version in `pdfjs.config` by @timvandermeij in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21843
* Update dependencies to the most recent versions by @timvandermeij in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21844
* Improve the runtime of Chrome tests by @timvandermeij in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21846
* Fix the adjacent-page reordering integration test by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21847
* Implement unit tests for the error cases in `src/core/xml_parser.js` by @timvandermeij in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21848
* Use arrow functions consistently with Promise `catch` methods by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21849
* Fix the [Object] param entry in createAndAddNewEditor and three similar slips by @darkdi in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21850
* Fix incorrect text stroke width caused by stale pixel-width cache by @HyeryongChoi in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21829
* Remove old `info` logging from the "GetOperatorList"/"GetTextContent" handlers (issue 21836) by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21840
* Get the l10n arguments at once in `PDFDocumentProperties.prototype.#parsePageSize` by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21856
* Move checks into the `ScreenAnnotation.#isPlayAction` method by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21862
* Remove the unused `fallback` parameter from `L10n.prototype.get` by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21857
* Add a helper to reduce duplication in the `collectActions` function by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21863
* [api-minor] Expose the `operatorList` to the `operationsFilter` callback function (issue 20399) by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21868
* Bump github/codeql-action/analyze from 4.37.7 to 4.37.8 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21864
* Bump github/codeql-action/autobuild from 4.37.7 to 4.37.8 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21865
* Bump github/codeql-action/init from 4.37.7 to 4.37.8 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21866
* Set `deployment: false` on the `code-coverage` environment jobs by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21853
* Add JSDoc linting by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21855
* Account for the Firefox font size quantization in the text layer by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21810
* Bump fast-uri from 3.1.5 to 3.1.7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21875
* Bump @humanfs/node from 0.16.7 to 0.16.8 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21876
* Address the high-severity zizmor findings by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21854
* Fix the fill area computation for a rotated tiling pattern by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21880
* Fix the vertical alignment of the views manager header by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21871
* Use moz-message-bar for the Firefox features notification (bug 2057608) by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21874
* Replace simple callback functions with arrow functions by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21879
* l10n: Update locale files by @sync-l10n-for-pdf-js[bot] in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21882
* Improve the filename extension detection in `MediaAnnotation.prototype._getContentType` by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21887
* Shorten some Pattern-handling code a little bit by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21893
* Convert the font `seacMap` and `seacs` structures into Maps by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21884
* Modernize the `MessageHandler` class by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21883
* Convert the `CmdCache`, `NameCache`, and `RefCache` to use Maps by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21888
* Wait for the deferred focus changes in the editor integration tests by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21892
* Remove the unused `@babel/runtime` dependency by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21894
* Replace `kleur` with `util.styleText` by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21895
* Use `@napi-rs/canvas` for PNG decoding in integration tests by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21896
* Fix TextWidgetAnnotation not inheriting text alignment from AcroForm by @diogotcorreia in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21886
* Keep the ToUnicode mapping of unencoded glyphs in non-embedded Type1 fonts by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21872
* Avoid a CPU DoS when auto-sizing text fields (bug 2069428) by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21889
* Fix comment tooltip and highlight test races by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21897
* Prevent NaN values in sampled functions with a degenerate Domain by @NakuRei in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21891
* Make `Ref.fromString` more strict, by not accepting "bad" arguments by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21898
* Move the the `interpolate` helper, such that it can be re-used more in `src/core/function.js` code by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21905
* Convert the `CFFOffsetTracker` offsets into a Map by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21910
* Convert the `missingGlyphs`, used in the `Font` class, into a Set by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21911
* Bump actions/deploy-pages from 5.0.0 to 5.0.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21908
* Keep editing disabled when switching documents by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21901
* Bump github/codeql-action/analyze from 4.37.8 to 4.37.9 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21909
* Bump github/codeql-action/init from 4.37.8 to 4.37.9 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21907
* Bump github/codeql-action/autobuild from 4.37.8 to 4.37.9 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21906
* Fix few intermittents in integration tests with Chrome by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21902
* Don't crash when a transfer function array contains /Identity entries by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21903
* Add a software fallback for transfer maps by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21912
* Wait for editor focus before integration test input by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21913
* [GeckoView] Add typed signatures (bug 2069485) by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21900
* Use platform print-to-PDF for FreeText appearances (bug 1794809) by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21858
* Replace `forEach` callback functions with arrow functions by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21915
* Remove the `ViewHistory.prototype.{get, set}` methods by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21914
* Add a way to run the reference tests from a PR label by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21918
* Use a "normal" import statement to access the `importPrintedAppearances` function, in the `src/core/worker.js` file (PR 21858 follow-up) by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21923
* Let the reftest analyzer load images from absolute URLs by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21928
* Fix the magnifier of the reftest analyzer when the images are displayed scaled by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21930
* Fix the DirectWrite rendering mode used by the reference tests on Windows by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21931
* Bump library version to `6.4` by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21929
* Pin all the ClearType parameters used by the reference tests on Windows by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21932
* l10n: Update locale files by @sync-l10n-for-pdf-js[bot] in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21933
* Bump js-yaml by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21919
* Add unit tests checking that a CMap's own mappings take precedence over usecmap ones by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21916
* Add a badge showing whether the reference images are up to date by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21925
* Stub out `OptionalContentConfig`, `FontLoader`, and `FontFaceObject` code when building for workers by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21926
* Avoid manual loops when generating some simple Arrays/TypedArrays by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21935
* Run the "gets current workerSrc" unit-test in Node.js (PR 17055 follow-up) by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21937
* Utilize Fluent better when localizing the `PDFDocumentProperties` dialog by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21938
* Update dependencies to the most recent versions by @timvandermeij in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21940
* Fix intermittent failures in the `PDFDocumentProperties` tests (PR 21938 follow-up) by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21941
* Use the `waitForTooltipToBe` helper function in the annotation integration tests by @timvandermeij in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21943
* Change the `FontFaceObject.prototype.getPathGenerator` cache into a Map by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21947
* Inline the `_loadTestFont` definition in the `FontLoader.prototyp._prepareFontLoadEvent` method by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21948
* Use the `waitForTextToBe` helper function in the editor undo bar integration tests by @timvandermeij in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21949
* Re-factor the `FontLoader.prototype.isFontLoadingAPISupported` getter by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21950
* Use the `waitForTextToBe` helper function in the editor alert bar integration tests by @timvandermeij in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21951
* Re-factor the test-font fallback loading in the `FontLoader` class by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21952
* Use the `waitForTextToBe` helper function in the remaining integration tests by @timvandermeij in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21953
* Convert the `CFFDict` classes to use Maps, rather than plain Objects by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21955
* Mark `IdentityCMap.prototype.getMap` as unreachable by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21956
* Use grayscale text antialiasing in Windows Firefox tests by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21945
* Allow tests to reuse installed browsers by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21963
* Convert `charCodeToGlyphId`, used in various font-code, into a Map by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21961
* Fix two FreeText integration tests when running headed on a HiDPI screen by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21962
* Define the "argument is Dictionary" callback validation function just once by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21967
* [Firefox] Remove the about:pdf href from the PDF features notification link (bug 2071624) by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21964
* Fix unexpected border-radius on the pdfFeaturesNotification bar (bug 2071593) by @jsimplicio in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21966
* Remove the `createWithNullProto` helper from the `CFFParser` unit-tests by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21973
* Add a helper function for writing array-data in `compileFontInfo` by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21976
* Validate embedded media content types by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21977
* Recover from browser startup and reload failures by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21944
* l10n: Update locale files by @sync-l10n-for-pdf-js[bot] in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21979
* Update JBIG2 decoder to pdfium@bb1f9f71 by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21980
* Defer the Firefox features notification until after first-page rendering (bug 2072145) by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21981
* Settle editor focus before `page.focus` in integration tests by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21982
* Convert the `Differences` Array, used with non-composite fonts, into a Map by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21984
* Convert the `toFontChar` Array, in the `Font` class, into a Map by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21985
* Tighten xref stream field-width validation by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21987
* Update dependencies to the most recent versions by @timvandermeij in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21986
* [api-minor] Stop sending a separate "test" message during Worker loading by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21988
* Limit cumulative CMap range entries by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21989
* Enable the `unicorn/prefer-combined-guards` linting rule by @timvandermeij in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21990
* Remove CLAUDE.md in favor of AGENTS.md by @jarrensj in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21983
* Bump codecov/codecov-action from 7.0.0 to 7.1.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22006
* Bump github/codeql-action/analyze from 4.37.9 to 4.38.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22004
* Bump github/codeql-action/autobuild from 4.37.9 to 4.38.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22005
* Bump github/codeql-action/init from 4.37.9 to 4.38.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22007
* Enable the `unicorn/prefer-set-methods` linting rule by @timvandermeij in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21992
* Remove some redundant loop variables by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22008
* Increase the browser protocol timeout by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21995
* Remove unnecessary Array copying in the `PatternInfo` class (PR 20340 follow-up) by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22003
* Enable the `unicorn/prefer-smaller-scope` linting rule by @timvandermeij in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21993
* Enable the `unicorn/prefer-short-arrow-method` linting rule by @timvandermeij in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21994
* Route worker messages using stable page IDs by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22000
* Convert the `CMap` and `ToUnicodeMap` classes to store its data in Maps by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21975
* Preserve escaped literals in util.printd by @Shubham-Padkonde in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21965
* l10n: Update locale files by @sync-l10n-for-pdf-js[bot] in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22018
* Use a Uint8Array to track missing TrueType glyphs (bug 2075570) by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22025
* Add a helper function for writing buffer-data in `compileFontInfo` by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22022
* Introduce a helper to reduce duplication when reading compiled string-data from fonts by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22019
* Avoid scanning identity /ToUnicode maps for font fallback (bug 2075550) by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22027
* Add helper functions for encoding and writing strings in `src/core/obj_bin_transform_core.js` by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22016
* Remove unneeded `async` functions when creating StructTreeRoot-data during saving (PR 19026) by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22015
* Remove the unused `SystemFontInfo.prototype.guessFallback`  getter by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22026
* Reset the descendants of non-terminal fields in a ResetForm action by @fstandhartinger in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22014
* Stop exporting the Font `defaultWidth` by default by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22028
* Bound CFF INDEX and FDArray parsing by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22037
* Use `srcPos` for the remaining pixels in `convertRGBToRGBA` by @Prafyl in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22036
* Stop exporting the Font `defaultVMetrics` by default by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22042
* Use the glyph width for the default vertical origin by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22047
* Reset the descendants of non-terminal fields in Doc.resetForm by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22034
* Update OpenJpeg to 8314119b067c0fc77834731168daaebd379fdb12 by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22049
* Bump markdown-it from 14.2.0 to 14.3.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22055
* Bump undici from 7.29.0 to 7.30.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22053
* Bump brace-expansion by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22054
* Bump codecov/codecov-action from 7.1.0 to 7.1.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22031
* Bump github/codeql-action/analyze from 4.38.0 to 4.38.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22030
* Bump github/codeql-action/autobuild from 4.38.0 to 4.38.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22032
* Bump github/codeql-action/init from 4.38.0 to 4.38.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22033
* Stop exporting the Font `mimetype` property by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22038
* Directly lookup entries in the `cidToGidMap` when building the `charCodeToGlyphId` map, for embedded composite fonts by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22056
* Bound tiling pattern folding work for tiny steps by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22012
* Shadow the getters in `FontInfo`, `CssFontInfo`, and `SystemFontInfo` (PR 20197 follow-up) by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22035
* Stop exporting the Font `name` by default by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22057
* Stop passing `extra` properties to the `FontInfo` class by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22059
* Avoid resetting the text-layer measurement font by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22058
* Stop exporting the Font `ascent` and `descent` by default, and remove handling of standalone number entries in the compiled font-info by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22060
* Check shading function dimensions and bound sampled interpolation by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22041
* Convert `SupportedImageMimeTypes` into a Set by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22061
* Update dependencies to the most recent versions by @timvandermeij in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22062
* Avoid creating a pointless `requestId` in the `ChunkedStreamManager.prototype._requestChunks` method by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22064
